Remove existing wall flashings to a workable surface and dispose of debris. Remove existing perimeter metal edge and dispose of debris. Install a layer of 1/2" HD ISO roof board. Weld width shall be 2" in width for hand welding. Upon completion of welding, each seam shall be probed to ensure proper securement. Install new wall flashings. Install new perimeter metal edge.
